notes_for_editor: Build date 1934 rests on the Eastern US Lookouts list; the Oct 1933 notice is an announcement of a plan, not a completion record, and no completion record was found. The list's 'Moonlight' name is not explained in the cached page. Height 99 ft 9 in converted to 30.4 m; the list does not say whether this is tower height above ground. The 1933 notice gives the site only as four miles west of the town, which was not checked against the statewide list's coordinates. No source found on staffing, fires, later history, access or the site today. Brief check: status and access unknown are correct; the NGS entry (FX 4173) matches the statewide list. No corrections. No photos added. Next checks: NC Forest Service or 1930s state biennial reports, and any 1934 newspaper report of the tower's completion. Fact-check 2026-10-21: no facts changed; one sentence reworded to stop copying the 1933 notice, and metres added after the tower height.
